documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For Period Ended June 30, 2026.
JUBLCPL: Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Unsecured Creditors To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Equity Shareholders To Be Held On September 05, 2026.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported its audited financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, showing consolidated revenue of INR 18,911 million and a PAT of INR 1,279 million for FY26. Management highlighted robust demand in adhesives supported by GST rate reductions, growth in agri products due to better placement of single super phosphate, and ongoing input cost pressures. The company also provided updates on its upcoming polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, and the progress of its agri business demerger. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million in Q3 FY26, representing a 13% year-on-year growth. The Board of Directors approved a capacity expansion of 30,000 MTPA for Performance Polymers at its Samlya site with an investment of approximately INR 50 Crores financed through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: The company is focused on achieving profitable and volume-led growth by introducing innovative new products and expanding its channels.

guidance.quote: Stable input costs environment enable continued strategic A&P-led demand generation

guidance.claim: Pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27 following pressure on EBITDA margins from raw material input costs.
guidance.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

guidance.claim: Management expects input costs to remain stable in Q3 FY26 alongside continued strategic spending on advertising and promotion.
guidance.quote: Input Cost to remain stable for Q3 FY26 and continue focus on demand generation thru strategic A&P spends

demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth

capex_expansion.claim: The company will commence its state-of-the-art polymer adhesive manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the expansion of Performance Polymers manufacturing capacity by setting up a facility at the Samlya site in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity expansion requires an investment of approximately INR 50 Crores.
The Board approved a capex of approximately Rs. 50 crore to set up new manufacturing facilities at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed expansion will add 30,000 MT per annum to the manufacturing capacity of the Performance Polymers business.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

margins_costs.quote: Input cost inflation persists; mitigating impact through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing

margins_costs.claim: Lower input costs supported EBITDA margins in the adhesives division.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were supported by lower input costs

margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: An increased mix of value-added products contributed to improved margins and revenue performance.
margins_costs.quote: An increase in value-added product mix supported better margins and revenue performance

margins_costs.claim: Lower input costs supported healthy EBITDA margins in the adhesives segment.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained healthy supported by Lower input cost

margins_costs.quote: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins impacted due to subdued demand

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity stands at 80,000 MTPA for polymers and chemicals, and 400,000 MTPA for single super phosphate.
orders_capacity.quote:
TOTAL CAPACITY
Polymers and Chemicals: 80,000 MTPA
Single Super Phosphate: 400,000 MTPA

orders_capacity.claim: The existing total capacity for Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.
The existing capacity utilization is approximately 79%.
The proposed capacity addition for Performance Polymers is 30,000 MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital deployment was increased for better placement during the off-season and is expected to be liquidated by Q1 FY27.
The capital expenditure for capacity expansion will be funded through internal accruals.
The draft demerger scheme for transferring the Agri business has been filed with Stock Exchanges and is awaiting approvals.
capital_allocation.quote: The draft scheme has been filed with the Stock Exchanges and is awaiting approval from SEBI/ Stock Exchanges.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the demerger of the company's Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger of its Agri Division between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (Demerged company) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (Resulting Company).

capital_allocation.claim: The share exchange ratio for the Agri Division demerger is set at 1:1.
The Rs. 50 crore capex will be funded predominantly through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
